name: Sandbox Mode
displayDescription:
All items in build mode will cost $0, allowing you to build as much as you want for free, including chairs, tables and decorations

Notes:
- Does not automatically purchase expansion upgrades or floor upgrades.
- Does not work in other player's plots

name: Auto Money Collection
displayDescription:
- All money on tables will be collected automatically
- Allows player to earn money passively

name: Allow Build Collisions
displayDescription:
- Increases the item collision limits in build mode by 5x
- Overlap furniture items
- Overlap roofs and floors more freely

Notes:
- Doors and windows cannot be overlapped (at least at the moment)
- Collisions will not be infinite, the game will still prevent you from placing an crazy amount of items on top of each other (this is to prevent lag!)
- Does not work in other player's plots

name: Precision Build
displayDescription:
- Access to precision build mode
- Rotate items freely
- Move items freely
- Move items vertically
- Ability to change grid size to 0.1 when placing all furniture
- Change floor height

Notes:
- Some items like doors, windows, roof, floor, do not support precision build mode.
- All normal furniture supports precision build mode.
- Does not work in other player's plots

name: 3x Customer Luck
displayDescription:
Boost your chances of getting rare customers by 3x

Includes birthday customers, food critics, VIP customers, and any future special customers that are added. This stacks on top of the other in-game luck boosts.

INCREASES ALL CUSTOMER CHANCES BY 3x

VIP Customer - Increases chance from 0.4% to 1.2%
Birthday Customer - Increases chance from 0.27% to 0.82%
Food Critic - Increases chance from 0.2% to 0.6% (2 stars required)
Celebrity - Increases chance from 0.125% to 0.375% (3 stars required)
Rude Customer - Increases chance from 0.5% to 1.5%
Chip Shop Diva - Increases chance from 0.16% to 0.5%

name: 2x Item Limits
displayDescription:
Are you running into issues with the item limits?
- Place 2x the max amount of walls, wall furniture, small decorations, roofs, floors, doors, roof furniture, and pillars!

Notes:
- Does not work in other player's plots

name: 2x Milestone Boost
displayDescription:
Every milestone will level up 2x faster!

Note: Sometimes you have to do different actions to level up the milestone. For example, the gardening milestone requires both placing nature items, and using the farm.
